purpose: Fixed reference board and construction ledger for the fourteen reviewed Yosemite icons.
copyrightBoundary: Historical Apple artwork is research-only evidence. Production PNGs are original measured reconstructions and semantic adaptations. No screenshot crop, extracted resource, or traced Apple path ships as a runtime asset.

systemRules.sizePolicy: Runtime surfaces downscale the 128 px master. The twelve programmatic cores own separately composed 64 px, 32 px, and 16 px review hints with thickened structure and merged parts; the two accepted Image Gen cores use separately processed ledger artifacts.
systemRules.light: Soft light from above and slightly in front. Shading is shallow: broad, clean gradients rather than modelled material. One short contact shadow only where an object overlaps another.
systemRules.perspective: Flattened but object-specific. Paper and folders are front-on, hardware is front-on with a shallow top face, and no object is tilted into a desk perspective the way 10.6 tilts it.
systemRules.silhouette: Free-form per object. Yosemite did not put Mac icons in one rounded-square container, so only the objects whose real 10.10 prototype is a rounded square use one.
systemRules.palette: Brighter and cleaner than 10.6, with cyan-leaning blues, taken from the measured reference board rather than invented.
systemRules.depth: Overlap, one thin keyline, and a small amount of inner shading carry depth. No heavy bevel, no photographic texture, no large cast shadow.
systemRules.alpha: Anti-aliased edges with artwork-owned shading. No theme filter, saturate, or drop-shadow turns another era's artwork into Yosemite.
systemRules.smallArt: At 32 remove secondary objects and keep one dominant cue. At 16 merge or move parts to protect recognition.
systemRules.toolbarBoundary: Finder artwork is never reused as toolbar or sidebar art; 10.10 states those as separate, simpler symbol families.
systemRules.grid: Every object is placed on the shared icon grid in scripts/lib/icon-grid.mjs: one live dimension per shape class (square, portrait, landscape) with a margin that no object may cross, plus small optical allowances for shapes that read large or small at equal bounds. Objects are scaled uniformly, never stretched, so a row reads as one family while each object keeps its own proportions.

continuityRule: System objects reproduce the real 10.10 prototype. The seven AI System 6 objects keep the metaphorKey recorded in assets/themes/icon-system-continuity.json, drawn again in 2014 language rather than flattened from the 10.6 artwork.

webReference.kind: Collected 10.10 application and system icon images
webReference.use: Silhouette, palette, detail density, and the per-object decision about whether a rounded-square container is period-correct.
webReference.redistribution: Local evidence only; ignored by git and excluded from every package.

captures.use: Finder icon-view scale, sidebar and toolbar treatment, System Preferences.
captures.redistribution: Copyrighted screenshots; local research and comparison only.

rejected.reason: An earlier draft set drawn in modern macOS language: squircle containers, gradient blobs, a single-letter TextEdit mark, and a node-graph DocMap. It fails the period test and is kept only as a negative control.
